fields.name: timeFormat
fields.label: Time format
fields.description: Choose a 24-hour or 12-hour clock. The scene refreshes once per minute by default; choose seconds only on fast-refresh panels.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Small caption
fields.description: Optional tiny caption above the date.

fields.name: ornamentalDetails
fields.label: Ornamental frame details
fields.description: Show the border, horizon shape, and side accent marks.

fields.name: dateBox
fields.label: Date box and rule
fields.description: Show the box around the date text and the line above it.

fields.name: backgroundStyle
fields.label: Background texture style
fields.description: Optional gallery-inspired dithered background for e-ink panels.

typographicClockPanel.name: Typographic clock panel
typographicClockPanel.description: Responsive editorial SVG clock panel with optional dithered gallery-style background texture.

sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Typographic clock panel",
  "category": "data",
  "description": "Responsive editorial SVG clock panel with themes, date options, and optional background decoration.",
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "time",
      "label": "Time",
      "type": "string",
      "required": true
    },
    {
      "name": "dateRaw",
      "label": "Date as YYYY-MM-DD",
      "type": "string",
      "required": true
    },
    {
      "name": "dateStyle",
      "label": "Date style",
      "type": "select",
      "options": [
        "weekday-month-day",
        "short-weekday",
        "iso",
        "none"
      ],
      "value": "weekday-month-day"
    },
    {
      "name": "subtitle",
      "label": "Small caption",
      "type": "string",
      "value": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "theme",
      "label": "Theme",
      "type": "select",
      "options": [
        "midnight-gallery",
        "classic-black-on-white",
        "classic-white-on-black",
        "warm-paper",
        "sepia-press",
        "blueprint",
        "forest-mist",
        "terracotta",
        "plum-night",
        "slate-gold",
        "red-gallery",
        "green-room",
        "sandstone",
        "custom"
      ],
      "value": "midnight-gallery"
    },
    {
      "name": "backgroundGradient",
      "label": "Background gradient",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "true"
    },
    {
      "name": "decorativeElements",
      "label": "Background texture",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "true"
    },
    {
      "name": "ornamentalDetails",
      "label": "Ornamental frame details",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "true"
    },
    {
      "name": "dateBox",
      "label": "Date box and rule",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "true"
    },
    {
      "name": "textColor",
      "label": "Main numeral color",
      "type": "color",
      "value": "#F7F1E3"
    },
    {
      "name": "dateColor",
      "label": "Date color",
      "type": "color",
      "value": "#D8CBA8"
    },
    {
      "name": "accentColor",
      "label": "Accent color",
      "type": "color",
      "value": "#D9A441"
    },
    {
      "name": "backgroundStart",
      "label": "Background top color",
      "type": "color",
      "value": "#132238"
    },
    {
      "name": "backgroundEnd",
      "label": "Background bottom color",
      "type": "color",
      "value": "#2A1E3F"
    },
    {
      "name": "backgroundStyle",
      "label": "Background texture",
      "type": "select",
      "options": [
        "none",
        "soft-gallery",
        "poster-dither"
      ],
      "value": "poster-dither"
    },
    {
      "name": "fontFamily",
      "label": "Clock font",
      "type": "font",
      "value": "PTSans-Bold.ttf"
    }
  ],
  "output": [
    {
      "name": "image",
      "type": "image"
    }
  ],
  "permissions": []
}
